sources.title: AI Features Don't Fail Tests. They Fail Differently Every Time.
sources.snippet: Traditional unit tests break for AI features because LLMs are non-deterministic — the same input produces different outputs, and semantically equivalent outputs fail string matching. Most teams have no replacement strategy. The fix is eval-driven development: behavioral contracts, golden datasets, and LLM-as-judge scoring against defined rubrics.

sources.title: SocioEval: A Template-Based Framework for Evaluating Socioeconomic ...
sources.snippet: However, existing approaches to socioeco-nomic bias remain limited in scope, often focusing on nar-row scenarios or lacking systematic evaluation frameworks that can scale across models and contexts. We introduce SocioEval, a template-based framework for systematically evaluating socioeconomic status bias in foun-dation models.
